description: Issues #223 / #224: the `gates:` notation carries CommandMate #1771 / #1772's three fields. Upstream runs ONE validator over both `.commandmate/verify.yaml` gates and a contract's `verify.gateDefinitions` (verify-config.ts `validateGateEntries`), so a key accepted there has to be accepted here — a block the planner refuses is an acceptance condition its author cannot state, and a block the planner accepts and `send --contract` refuses is an exit 2 about a worker that never ran. The transcription is a COPY, as everywhere in this notation: author order, `flakyIsPass: false` written out because the author wrote it (it is the default made explicit, which is legal), and `timeoutSec` still ABSENT on the entries that declared none. `flakyIsPass: true` is accepted here because the same entry declares `retryOnFail: 1`; case 86 is the other side of that rule.
